entries.title: Psalms 120:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> In my trouble I called unto Jehovah, and he answered me.

entries.title: Psalms 120:2
segments: Jehovah, deliver my soul from the lying lip, from the deceitful tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 120:3
segments: What shall be given unto thee, what shall be added unto thee, thou deceitful tongue?

entries.title: Psalms 120:4
segments: Sharp arrows of a mighty one, with burning coals of broom-wood.

entries.title: Psalms 120:5
segments: ¶Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

entries.title: Psalms 120:6
segments: My soul hath long dwelt with them that hate peace.

entries.title: Psalms 120:7
segments: I [am for] peace; but when I speak, *they* [are] for war.
